hypothesis: AGVE withdrawTo(address,uint256) is a stranger-reachable token payout path (live probe succeeded). Chained sequence: first mint 1 AGVE to the stranger via mintTo, then withdrawTo 0.5 AGVE to the stranger. The fork shows whether withdrawTo burns the stranger's balance, pays out underlying value, or reverts.
